items.title: Marshall Allen interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 19, 2021
items.q: I wanted to play like Johnny Hodges.

ctx.x: You know we celebrate Freddie Green and Harry Carney for how long they stayed with Basie and Ellington, but you’ve got them beat by quite a bit.
Yeah. Well you know I admired all of those although I was looking up to them, I wanted to play like Johnny Hodges.
Yeah as a matter of fact, one of the well known critics described, “Here’s Marshall Allen’s playing as Johnny Hodges from another dimension.”
